item.title: Suffering’s Brutal Truth: A Veteran’s Raw Lesson on Enduring Endless Pain

Today I know the brutal truth: suffering isn't solved, it's survived through raw, unglamorous defiance that forges meaning from the void #Headline #SOFREP #RyanBrazil #Pain #Suicide #22aday

item.title: DARPA Blackjack: Proving Resilient Military Space at Commercial Scale
